title: Alignment and Safety in Large Language Models: Safety Mechanisms, Training Paradigms, and Emerging Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model fairness using the PRISM benchmark dataset by calculating demographic parity difference and equalized odds difference metrics to assess whether positive prediction rates and label correctness are equitable across groups defined by sensitive attributes.

Analyzing live model conversations and feedback on value-laden and culturally sensitive topics across populations from 75 countries (including census-representative samples) using the PRISM benchmark.

Assessing the degradation of model alignment and instruction-following capabilities when processing inputs from underrepresented user groups or dialects due to a lack of demographic balance in fine-tuning data.
